_about: Each creature's portrait for the journal's Creatures tab (Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_ui_art.py creatures, 768x768 saved at 512), keyed by its MonsterDefinition asset's name. Head and shoulders or the whole beast, facing a little to one side, in its own place, described from its model in the game and its journal lore so the painting looks like what the player meets. Animals of the Haven's woods are painted in the warm style, the forest's own in the dark one.
BarrowShieldbearer: Portrait of a skeletal undead Norse warrior, a draug, in a rusted iron helmet and torn mail, holding up a big round wooden shield painted faded orange and a long spear, standing at the dark stone doorway of an ancient burial mound, cold blue mist.
Draug: Portrait of a skeletal undead Norse warrior, a draug, gaunt grey bones in a rusted helmet and torn chain mail, holding a notched old sword, cold blue light in its empty eye sockets, burial mounds and mist behind.
BlightBoar: Portrait of a cursed wild boar with dark bristling fur, long yellowed tusks and sickly glowing green eyes, rotten moss on its back, in a blighted thicket of dead brambles.

Boar.prompt: Portrait of a wild boar with coarse brown-grey fur, small tusks and a long snout, rooting in the leaves of a sunny Nordic birch forest.

WildBoar.prompt: Portrait of a big old wild boar with shaggy dark brown fur, long curved tusks and a scarred snout, standing alert in a pine forest at dusk.

Deer.prompt: Portrait of a roe deer doe with a soft reddish-brown coat and large dark ears, looking up alert in a sunlit meadow at the edge of a birch forest.

Stag.prompt: Portrait of a proud red deer stag with a great spread of antlers and a thick neck mane, standing in morning mist in a Nordic pine forest.

Fox.prompt: Portrait of a red fox with a bushy white-tipped tail and bright amber eyes, sitting among ferns and mossy stones in a Nordic forest.

BogSpitter: Portrait of a huge bloated toad-like swamp creature with no legs to speak of, a squat round body of pale mottled skin with green and yellow blotches and warts, a wide lipless mouth dripping green venom, small black eyes, half sunk in a dark bog with reeds and mist.
ForestBittenWolf: Portrait of a cursed grey wolf with matted fur, a lean scarred face and glowing green eyes, teeth bared, in a dark misty pine forest.
Huldra: Portrait of the huldra, a beautiful forest spirit woman with long flaxen hair crowned with flowers, a pale green blouse and dark skirt, looking back over her shoulder so that her back shows hollow like a rotten tree trunk, smiling faintly at the edge of a dark forest, an uncanny glow.
MarshLight: Portrait of a will-o'-the-wisp: a pale floating orb of soft blue-white light hovering over black marsh water among reeds and dead trees at night, its glow reflected in the water, faint mist.
Mistwing: Portrait of a large leathery flying creature like a giant bat with pale violet wings spread wide, a narrow snout and small hungry eyes, gliding low through thick grey mist between pine trunks.
MossShaman: Portrait of an old green-skinned troll shaman, hunched and wiry, with long ears and a wrinkled face, holding a twisted staff of living wood topped with a glowing pale orb, moss and leaves hanging from its shoulders, in a dark grove.
SmallMossTroll: Portrait of a small young troll with mossy green-yellow skin, big pointed ears, a wide grin and a stone held ready to throw, crouching on a mossy boulder in a forest.
OldMossTroll: Portrait of a huge ancient troll with a broad mossy back that has a small tree growing out of it, a great heavy face with weak little eyes and a long nose sniffing the air, walking through a misty valley of boulders.
RootGuardian: Portrait of a tall forest guardian made of twisted reddish-brown roots and bark in the shape of a gaunt man, with moss in its joints, a crown of short branches and faint amber light in its eyes, in a dark old forest.
Rootling: Portrait of a knee-high little creature of tangled roots and moss that has learned to walk, with a round body, twig arms and two tiny glowing amber eyes, standing among ferns and mushrooms.
TheHeartroot: Portrait of the Heartroot, a vast ancient guardian of twisted reddish-brown roots and bark grown into the shape of a towering figure, glowing amber heart-light deep in its hollow chest, vines and moss hanging from it, in a huge dark hollow under an enormous tree.
